text:
sarah_p: Heads-up — customer reported a permission spike on acct-redwood-prod around 2026-11-02 03:15 UTC. They say a bunch of service tokens were granted admin role for a short window. From our side the role-manager service shows a single automated override but the audit log entry for who triggered it has an empty actor field.
tyler_m: Can you paste the audit event? is actor literally null or service_account?

sarah_p: actor=null. here's the event JSON we pulled from audit-store (sanitized):
```
{"ts":"2026-11-02T03:15:27Z","event":"role.grant","target":"svc/payments-bridge","role":"admin","actor":null,"source":"role-manager-3","meta":{}}
```

mira_g: interesting — role-manager normally submits a KMS-signed request. If signature verification fails we still log the request but we should preserve the signer in "actor_meta" before decryption. that sounds like a decoding step dropped the actor.

kevin_r: I ran the indexer query: `SELECT id,ts,actor,target,source FROM audit_events WHERE target='svc/payments-bridge' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-11-02' AND '2026-11-03';` returned 3 events; only the 03:15 one has actor=null. Others show `svc/role-manager` as actor.
audit-bot: deploy-log: role-manager-3 rolled out at 2026-11-02T02:59:09Z -> image sha ghp:7a9c3f (config change: kms-client bump)

mira_g: that deploy included the KMS client update. suspect: new KMS client changes envelope format; our audit-ingest lambda expects legacy envelope -> actor extraction failed and we wrote null.

sarah_p: repro plan: replay role-manager request from logs through local audit-ingest with new and legacy decode paths and compare actor extraction. who can help replay?

tyler_m: I can run the replay in dev this afternoon. do we have the exact raw payload? we need the encrypted envelope and signature header.

kevin_r: I uploaded a redacted copy to the secure bucket at s3://redwood-sec/repro/2489012345/payload.enc (access limited). note: payload contains customer IDs so keep it in the repro bucket.

connie_c: From compliance POV we need a list of all role changes in Oct-Nov with null actors and a short explainable timeline for auditors. can you add that to the ticket? this single un-attributed grant will flag in our SOC report.

mira_g: ack. will run a full scan for `actor IS NULL` and also `actor = ''` across audit_events back 90 days. query I plan to run: `SELECT ts,target,source,meta FROM audit_events WHERE actor IS NULL OR actor = '' AND ts > now() - interval '90 days';` will attach results.

tyler_m: repro update: replayed payload through legacy decoder -> actor extracted as `svc/role-manager`. replayed through new KMS client -> decoder failed with `UnknownEnvelopeVersion: v3`; audit-ingest currently swallows the error and emits null actor. attaching stack trace: `Err(UnknownEnvelopeVersion) at kms/decode.rs:142`.

kevin_r: good catch. so two issues: (1) role-manager upgraded KMS client (v3), (2) audit-ingest didn't fail loudly and we end up with null actor. severity: medium-high (tamper/forgery risk + compliance gap).

connie_c: action items for auditors: timeline, count of affected events, whether any privileged actions were performed during those windows, and CHANGES to KMS clients or role-manager versions. please produce before EOD for me.

mira_g: I pushed a hotfix to audit-ingest to treat unknown envelope versions as a hard failure and log the raw payload to quarantine bucket (read-only) + emit an alert to #incidents. PR: github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/742

audit-bot: ci/build #742 passed. deploy to staging scheduled.

tyler_m: I'll coordinate a rollback of role-manager-3 if deploy to prod happened for any clusters beyond canary. timeline shows canary at 03:00, full roll at 03:10 — the offending event at 03:15 suggests full roll was active.

kevin_r: scanning for other null-actor events in that 03:10-03:20 window: found 12 grants and 2 revokes across svc/* with actor=null. none appear to be customer-facing data exports but some touched admin console permissions.

sarah_p: created INC-2026-11-02-01 and linked ticket TKT-1241 for compliance. I'll DM legal with the list once mira uploads the CSV.

connie_c: please include whether any KMS key rotation happened in the preceding 24h — rotation can change envelope formats in some customers' stacks. also confirm if KMS client change was backward incompatible.

mira_g: No key rotation AFAICT. KMS vendor changed envelope version only in new SDK. upgrade in role-manager included that new SDK; audit-ingest was not updated.

tyler_m: proposed mitigations: (1) temporary rollback role-manager to v2 client, (2) hard-fail ingest on unknown envelopes (done in hotfix), (3) backfill actors for affected events by reprocessing quarantined payloads after decoding with v3 support, (4) add integration test for envelope versions.

kevin_r: I'll prep backfill script and a safe-runbook to patch events with actor only after verifying signature chain. won't auto-assign admin if signature invalid.

sarah_p: thanks team. prioritize: rollback if prod still on v3, hotfix deploy, backfill plan. please post status updates here. :thumbsup:

mira_g: hotfix deployed to prod at 2026-11-02T05:40Z. quarantined 32 payloads. starting backfill dry-run now.

tyler_m: rollback not required — canary flagged issue and we mitigated before broader damage. will monitor.

connie_c: received interim report. will escalate to SOC and include recommended process change: require audit-ingest integration tests for every KMS SDK bump.

kevin_r: dry-run backfill completed; 14 events safely re-decoded and actor restored (svc/role-manager). 10 payloads failed signature verification and remain quarantined.

sarah_p: closing loop for now. filing postmortem note and tagging infra/eng-runtime for a post-deploy checklist item about KMS SDK changes. thanks everyone.
